newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish Wise Men see 96 public sector budget -13.4 bln DKK. [CORRECTED 09:47 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Danish Wise Men see 96 public sector budget -13.4 bln DKK. [CORRECTED 09:47 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects headline and text to read public sector budget as opposed to state budget.)
The independent Danish Economic Council said in its biannual report on Wednesday that it expected a 13.4 billion crown public sector budget deficit in 1996, falling to a 4.1 billion deficit in 1997.
In its previous report last May, the council, known as the Wise Men, predicted a 21.3 billion crown defict in 1996 and a 16.3 billion shortfall in 1997.
